method: Read-only call-site, source-asset, API lifetime and existing-evidence inspection. No new runtime tests or timing trials.
status: Public cutover incomplete. Current .a0 and .a0d compiler/MCP/editor routes still use historical readers.

counts.note: Tracked units are an asset inventory, not independent applications or proof every file is a standalone accepted program.

directProductionRoutes.note: Imports counted recursively under src; type-only backend imports of core are not evidence of a second source ingress.

layers.area: Compiler entry and filesystem source graph
layers.current: Standalone plain check can accept through the historical prebuilt checker and falls back to the TS CLI. link chooses canonical parse or Dense/.a0d parse and checkProgramUnits calls core.validate.
layers.required: One A0 source authority on all commands, including errors/resource refusals. Keep graph confinement, cycle/profile/duplicate ownership and injected storage policy. Route raw-file bytes through fatal UTF8 decoding before upload. Never use a legacy source parser as native failure fallback.

layers.area: Source grammar, validator and internal compiler IR
layers.current: TS canonical, Dense and candidate-flat grammar implementations coexist with historical paged A0 and Dense A0 readers. The full-word A0 grammar/checker is private. Optimizer/AVR/spec code also directly calls TS validateFunction/validate on transformed or synthetic IR.
layers.required: Retire duplicate source parsing from normal compilation. Keep typed IR/runtime/backend utilities. Route language-semantic IR checking through the shared A0 authority; retain old validation only as an isolated differential oracle or explicitly separate backend IR verifier without source acceptance authority.

layers.area: Formatting, revisions and retained source sessions
layers.current: A0 formatting/revision companion is optional. format/revision require the current result identity. Native linking returns a fresh TypedProgram spread and does not expose that live result. Parsed-unit snapshots survive checking but their original arena handles do not.
layers.required: Connect authentic retained file units to the same A0 formatter with explicit activation/lifetime rules. Preserve authoring metadata for edited structured IR. Keep historical revision serialization private and byte stable; it is not an alternate source syntax.

layers.current: EditSession uses canonical parseNode/parseOperand/parse/validateFunction and Dense translation chosen by each handle. Spec parsing/printing is also a reference-source path. Revision guards, dependency ordering, transactional rejection and exact fixes are public behavior.
layers.required: Use the same flat A0 grammar for function/instruction/contract payloads, preserving edit-command framing as a protocol rather than another source dialect. Complete authoring encoding and native spec JSON/repair payloads. Measure incremental accepted-edit work, not only whole-program parse latency.

layers.current: CLI exposes dense/canon commands and --dense/--dense=a0. MCP defaults to Dense views/replies with dense:false canonical opt-out; compact is a separate protocol experiment. Saves depend on destination extension. LSP uses legacy link, canonical formatting or a .a0d Dense branch.
layers.required: Cut views, edit payloads, saves, diagnostics, hints, completions and schema descriptions together to one flat spelling. Remove source-mode switches. Preserve semantic strict/default profiles and protocol/tool capability options. Preserve MCP A0807: saving a linked multi-file program to its original file is refused; save-as emits the flattened program.

layers.current: Public migrate targets Dense/.a0d; private migrateSourceProject targets flat using the reference TS source codec/link. Staging verifies comments, fixed points, semantic hashes, source bytes, containment and no overwrite. Sealed compilation uses the same legacy linker; source inventories and vault roles accept .a0/.a0d.
layers.required: Make flat the sole migration output, checked and printed by A0. Keep old-reader selection explicit only in the historical import command; do not guess ambiguous .a0 text. Preserve guarded staging and sealed virtual-source adapters, storage/confidentiality rules and managed-source path migration.

layers.current: Official seed and C/ARM64/Mach-O/Wasm tools still enter the historical paged reader. Private raw-source C stage uses the shared grammar and has reproduction controls, but is not the official seed. Full-word C output/package footprint remains a measured gate.
layers.required: Move every self-hosted source ingress to the shared grammar or checked internal IR, preserving existing backend capabilities. Prove native fixed points, source/behavior parity and the existing whole seed package size floor. Do not waive the floor or add a source-to-source shim before a legacy parser.

layers.area: Source assets, source generators and website
layers.current: Compiler, examples, site generator/pages/live apps, fixtures, seed chunks and snippets still use historical source spelling. Twenty-one .a0s authoring files generate compiler .a0; 91 Dense copies remain. Site build and generator link through the public legacy reader.
layers.required: Convert and verify live source plus generators that would overwrite it, regenerate seed/site/snippets, then remove duplicate Dense trees. Make .a0s research historical rather than a second maintained compiler-source language. Preserve original benchmark cells as explicitly historical controls rather than relabeling them unified.

layers.area: Editor assets, guides and installed bundles
layers.current: TextMate/Tree-sitter teach explicit canonical headers/types/pN, while skill/MCP guides teach a Dense default and a separate canonical opt-out. Release artifacts still package historical checker/CLI paths.
layers.required: One source guide and one default formatter across editor syntax support and distribution. Editor parsers remain syntax consumers, not semantic authorities. Generate/update fixtures and enforce conformance with the A0 frontend. Keep history/research and legal/SEO uses of canonical separate from source-mode removal.

arbitraryNumericIR.conclusion: Read-only follow-up inventory found no accepted source spelling that constructs invalid u32 payloads. MCP apply receives an edit string; runtime JSON arguments pass checkArgument, not arbitrary IR. Negative/fractional/NaN/infinite/out-of-range handbuilt operand quirks are not an accepted-source cutover blocker. Full arbitrary public Program parity would require an explicit contract decision; no promise is made here.

formattingActivationProposal.api: activateUnitForFormat(ownedUnit,budget?) -> opaque current formatting input; existing format/revision consume that input
formattingActivationProposal.ownership: Look up the original unit in this open engine private WeakMap before any arena mutation. Copy private scalar M/PS metadata with the existing owned source/table/symbol/type snapshots; never trust public result.state/program fields.
formattingActivationProposal.restore: Explicitly reset through generic IR initialization/upload, reintern original symbol/type IDs, rebind all handles/source references, restore imports and M24/M25/M26, and publish a matching PS directory. Do not use composeNativeUnits([unit]), which strips imports/promotes comments for graph composition.
formattingActivationProposal.authority: No source reparse, no TS formatter or checker, and no unchecked TypedProgram result. The existing A0 formatter remains authoritative.
formattingActivationProposal.lifecycle: Successful activation increments generation and explicitly invalidates earlier live graph/format inputs. Next parse/check/activation/close invalidates the new input. Foreign/closed requests reject before changing the current arena. Outputs are detached before any reset.
formattingActivationProposal.metadataCoordination: Parsed source units need their original M/PS tables, not A128. Future captured structured-authoring states must reupload/rebind A128 vectors and source pool rather than retaining session handles.
formattingActivationProposal.remainingMcpConnection: Edited MCP whole-Program formatting must connect the completed authoring encoder to the same A0 formatter; original multi-file save refusal remains. No per-file multi-file MCP editing feature is required.
